name: wrapped-and-context
description: A statement wrapped over three lines, a Context field wrapped over two, a Source field, and no trailing newline at end of file.
notes: Wrapping is source layout only: parts join with a single space and that joined form is what is rendered and matched. Fields render only in query, indented two spaces; the decide text never carries them. The file deliberately has no trailing newline, so 'no newline at end of file' is pinned to parse.

textIncludes: DEC-SAVE-001: A save file writes the whole run state in one transaction, and a failed write leaves the previous save intact and the game still playable.
Context: Players lose an hour of progress when a save is half-written, which is the one failure they will not forgive.
DEC-SAVE-002: A save is written once per level transition and never on a timer.
